chapter: Forming the band in New York
title: Buck dancing in the Apollo shows
summary: He did a buck dance during 'Sweet Georgia Brown' with Paul Bascomb.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Back at the time that you were playing this year in 1935, and playing this show, the band was just playing musical numbers? Were you part of the act in anyway? Did you have to do other non-musical things?

No. I used to have fun when the band was playing music. I used to get out there. When I had Paul Bascomb featured on "Sweet Georgia Brown", when he got down to the last chorus, I got out there and did my little dance in front of, you know, in the Apollo Theater. A lot of the theaters, I used to go out there and I used to buck dance a little bit. You know, I called it buck dancing in those days. I was doing no tapping. And, I'd go through my act. And, I used to do it with a fellow. That's about the biggest act there besides music.
